title: JPARK Mactan International Marathon 2026 Review: A Full Marathon on Cebu's Resort Island
seo_title: JPARK Mactan Marathon 2026 Review | Lapu-Lapu Cebu Philippines
meta_description: The JPARK Mactan International Marathon 2026: October 11 on Mactan Island, Cebu. Full marathon, half, 10K, and 5K with registration open — a resort-island marathon reviewed.
dek: Set for 11 October 2026 on Mactan Island in Lapu-Lapu City, Cebu, this JPARK Island Resort-backed marathon offers four distances with registration open. A full marathon on the island that's home to Cebu's international airport and luxury resorts.
verdict: The JPARK Mactan International Marathon brings a full marathon to Mactan Island — the resort-island connected to Cebu by bridge, home to luxury hotels, dive spots, and the Mactan-Cebu International Airport. Four distances (42K, 21K, 10K, 5K) with registration open. The JPARK Island Resort backing gives it resort-level production values, and Mactan's coastal roads provide a flat, scenic course. October in Cebu is the transition into the northeast monsoon — warm but manageable. For runners wanting a Cebu marathon with resort-island convenience, this is a strong pick.

sections.heading: Mactan: Cebu's Resort Island
paragraphs: Mactan Island is connected to Cebu City by bridge and is home to the international airport, luxury beachfront resorts, and some of the best diving in the Visayas. [1] A marathon here means flat coastal roads, resort-backed amenities, and post-race recovery that includes beachfront pools and spa treatments.
